title: Sweeping someone else’s doorway
odia:
ତା ଦୁଆରେ ଖତ କୁଢ
ସିଏ ପର ଦୁଆର ଓଳଉଚି।
literal_meaning: A heap of manure lies at their own doorway; they are sweeping someone else’s doorway.
meaning_odia: ନିଜ ଦୁଆରେ ଖତର କୁଢ଼ ପଡ଼ିଛି, ଅଥଚ ସିଏ ପର ଦୁଆର ଓଳାଉଛି। ଆମ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟାରେ, ନିଜ ଆଗରେ ଥିବା ଅବହେଳିତ କାମକୁ ଛାଡ଼ି ଅନ୍ୟର କାମ ସଜାଡ଼ିବାରେ ବ୍ୟସ୍ତ ହେବାର ଏହା ଚିତ୍ର। ଅନ୍ୟକୁ ସୁଧାରିବାକୁ ଯିବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ନିଜ ଅବସ୍ଥାକୁ ଦେଖିବାର ଭାବ ଏଥିରୁ ବୁଝିହୁଏ।
explanation: The two doorways make the contradiction visible: the person leaves a heap at home while putting effort into cleaning elsewhere. Our editorial reading is about neglected priorities, and by extension attending to others’ faults while leaving one’s own affairs unattended.
usage_example: Original imagined example: Someone repeatedly reorganises a colleague’s documents while leaving their own overdue work untouched. A friend compares that misplaced effort to sweeping another doorway with a heap at one’s own.
cultural_context: The repetition of ଦୁଆର turns one everyday task into a comparison between here and elsewhere. The source specifies the neglected heap but gives no reason why the person has chosen the other doorway.

witnesses.locator: Page21, couplet beginning ତା ଦୁଆରେ after the palm-leaf verse.
witnesses.note: Rendered upload inspected17November2026; exact spelling retained, including କୁଢ and ଓଳଉଚି. Literal reads heap and sweeping contextually; priorities explanation is editorial.

english_summary: Effort goes to another’s doorstep while one’s own remains neglected.
